about.title: About
about.text1: I'm a passionate Full-Stack Developer who enjoys building modern, user-friendly web applications. I love turning ideas into real products and constantly learning new technologies to create better experiences.
about.text2: When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring space (virtually), listening to music, or sketching ideas for my next project.

taskflow.title: GodArt
taskflow.description: E-commerce platform for a stationery store, featuring a product catalog, variations, shopping cart, online payments, and order management. It includes an administrative panel for managing products, inventory, promotions, customers, carousels, and store content.

posElectron.title: POS electron
posElectron.description: A comprehensive, high-performance Point of Sale (POS) system designed specifically for stationery stores and retail businesses. Its built on a hybrid architecture that combines a native desktop interface using Electron with a lightweight PHP backend API and MySQL.

Osseous.title: Osseous
Osseous.description: E-commerce platform featuring a shopping cart, online payments, and order tracking.

black-jack.title: black-jack
black-jack.description: My personal black-jack, built with React and Tailwind CSS, showcasing my projects and skills as a developer.

gifexpertapp.title: GifExpertApp
gifexpertapp.description: A web application that allows users to search and view animated GIFs using the Giphy API. Users can enter search terms and explore a wide variety of GIFs related to their interests.
